sn56.24:1.2: ye hi keci bhikkhave atītamaddhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā yathābhūtaṃ abhisambujjhiṃsu sabbe te cattāri ariyasaccāni yathābhūtaṃ abhisambujjhiṃsu.
sn56.24:1.3: yepi hi keci bhikkhave anāgatamaddhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā yathābhūtaṃ abhisambujjhissanti sabbe te cattāri ariyasaccāni yathābhūtaṃ abhisambujjhissanti.
sn56.24:1.4: yepi hi keci bhikkhave etarahi arahanto sammāsambuddhā yathābhūtaṃ abhisambujjhanti sabbe te cattāri ariyasaccāni yathābhūtaṃ abhisambujjhanti.
sn56.24:2.2: dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ dukkhasamudayo ariyasaccaṃ dukkhanirodho ariyasaccaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ.
sn56.24:2.3: yepi hi keci bhikkhave atītamaddhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā yathābhūtaṃ abhisambujjhiṃsu
sn56.24:2.5: abhisambujjhanti sabbe te imāni cattāri ariyasaccāni yathābhūtaṃ abhisambujjhanti.
sn56.24:3.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yogo karaṇīyoti.
